## Phase 0 — context load

Contract read in full. Load list honoured: G3 §5.5 (the V-table verbatim —
S = V1–V15 full set, P = V1-sample/V3/V4/V5-sample/V7/V10-new+sample/P1/V13),
§6.4 (V7's parity rule), §7.3 (classifier bounds V14 feeds), §8.1 (the
rollback the auto-path invokes), the on-failure paragraph (automatic rollback
pre-authorised D-G3-8 + alert + incident note); L3 §3.3 + ADR-154 (V15 =
`run_release_gate` over `sig.quality-report/1`: 0 ratchet regressions + 0
enforce failures + 0 not-evaluable enforce; `class_s_trigger` → Class S
signal); `release_publish_verify.py` (`api_parity_check` — invoked, never
duplicated); `release_reversal.py` (`verb_rollback`, `conf_gen_probe`,
`check_authority`); `release_conf.py` (`verb_promote`'s post-check branch —
the auto-rollback hook point); `alerts.py` (`fire`/`AlertLedger` — record
before delivery); `probe_run.py` (`sig.probe-run/1`); `scheduled.py`
(`TargetSpec`/`resolve_targets`/`probe_hosted`); `exports.release`
(`apply_withdrawals`' deny-map + `sig.tombstone/1` bodies — V10's expected
set); `exports.quality` (`run_release_gate` — V15's engine);
`ops/publish.py` (attribution/licence machinery — V8's basis);
`policy.source_aliases` (the personal-handle table — V8's DR-C3-13 leg);
`web/src/lib/figures.ts` + `Figure.astro` (the `data-artifact`/`data-pointer`/
`data-figure-id`/`data-figure-value` contract — V6's surface);
`api/release_serving.py` + `basis_middleware.py` (the `X-SIG-Basis`/
`X-SIG-Release`/release-block contract — V7's served legs).

Key facts recorded before implementation:

- Suite A's `VerifyContext`/`Fetcher`/`_CHECK_FNS`/`run_suite`/`apply_waivers`
  shape is the extension point — Suite B appends checks, never forks.
- `TreeFetcher` gains a deny-map model: `conf/withdrawn_routes.conf`
  (the `apply_withdrawals` emission — `location = /alias { error_page 410
  /conf/tombstone/<h>.<ext>; return 410; }`) answers `410` + the route's own
  tombstone body — the same answer nginx gives, so V10 probes the tree
  origin honestly.
- V7's served half needs an API-origin fetcher: `VerifyContext.api_fetcher`;
  absent → the served legs are `skip` (which blocks). The publish-preflight
  half is `api_parity_check(work_dir, pub, artifacts)` over the staged tree.
- V10's expected alias set derives from the CURRENT `registry/withdrawals.json`
  dispositions × the staged tree (`_route_targets`-shaped read-only scan) —
  every alias probed must answer `410` with the route's own
  `sig.tombstone/1` body.
- V14 emits deltas, never a verdict: per-compartment record Δ, source-set Δ,
  licence-set Δ, route-set Δ, template-fingerprint Δ, version/schema Δ vs the
  current latest (`ctx.previous_dir`).
- V15 consumes `exports.quality.run_release_gate(report)` where the report
  is injected via `ctx.quality_report` (dict or path); absent → `skip`
  (blocks). `gate["class_s"]` surfaces as the suite's Class-S signal.
- The auto-rollback: `verb_promote`'s post-check failure branch gains an
  injected `on_post_failure` path — the default composes
  `release_reversal.verb_rollback(apply_=True, to=<prior latest pub>,
  reason=…, go=<authority name>)` where the authority record names
  D-G3-8/B-9, then fires `alerts.fire` + writes an append-only incident note
  under `registry/incidents/`. Rollback failures are themselves fail-closed
  and recorded.

## Phase 1 — plan + test matrix

_Resumed 2026-10-24 (the prior worker exited mid-Phase-1 — `49dc2461`
records the interruption; Phase-0 above is that worker's preserved WIP)._

### Implementation

- **`ops/src/ops/release_verify.py`** (+~1,320) — the suite-B half of the
  §5.5 table, appended to suite A's harness:
  - `CHECKS_S` → V1–V15; `CHECKS_P` → V1,V3,V4,V5,V7,V10,V13,P1;
    `P_V10_SAMPLE = 20`, `P1_MAX_AGE_DAYS = 35`.
  - `VerifyContext` gains `api_fetcher`, `previous_dir`, `previous_pub`,
    `covers`, `quality_report`, `v10_sample`, `cadence_path` — every new
    input is a fixture-seam or a declared skip.
  - `TreeFetcher` gains `deny_conf` + `tombstone_root`/`tombstones` +
    `conf_gen_header` — the deny map matches before origin bytes and
    answers `410` + the route's own `sig.tombstone/1` body, and every
    response carries `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` (V10/P1's served headers).
  - **V6** — scans `v/`+`s/` HTML for `data-artifact`/`data-pointer`/
    `data-figure-value` figure elements; each artifact must be
    figure-manifest-listed, exist under the release's `artifact/` space,
    load as JSON, and its JSON-pointer value recompute to the rendered
    figure; artifact as-of must match the descriptor's `as_of_world`.
    Unevaluable surface → skip legs (skip blocks).
  - **V7** — `release_publish_verify.api_parity_check(work_dir, pub,
    artifacts)` for the staged half verbatim; the served half compares
    canonical-JSON equality of every `r/<pub>/api/` slice document +
    checks `/` and `/health` name the release and non-release routes carry
    their live-spine basis label (the label term, not a live claim). No
    `api_fetcher` → the served legs skip (blocks).
  - **V8** — 0 `attribution_required` rows with empty attribution;
    `LICENCES.json` names licence+attribution per compartment; map pages
    name their upstream (`map_contributor`) holders; no source renders as
    a bare id or a `policy.source_aliases` handle-shaped name.
  - **V9** — 0 null-island/out-of-range points; the `covers` oracle
    catches surviving axis swaps (swapped inside, true pair outside);
    out-of-boundary points must be withheld (`point_withheld`) or
    disclosed-conflict rendered; dossier rollup geolocated counts equal
    the bulk recompute. Points present + no oracle → skip (blocks).
  - **V10** — re-derives the expected barrier over a throwaway registry
    mirror (`release_reversal.derive_withdrawal_barrier`), diffs it
    against the served generation's `withdrawn.conf`, then probes every
    alias (S) or all-new-since-last-release + a sha256-ordered 20-sample
    (P) for `410` + the correct tombstone body; `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` must
    equal the recorded generation.
  - **V14** — emits the six deltas vs the current latest (per-compartment
    records, source set, licence set, route set, template fingerprint,
    version/schema) as evidence; the §7.3 bounds (−2 %/+15 % total,
    −5 %/+50 % per compartment, a source losing >20 % or all records)
    are the failures. A first release records the unbounded-baseline
    skip.
  - **V15** — the hook only: loads `sig.quality-report/1` (dict or path;
    absent/unreadable → skip, which blocks) and hands it to
    `exports.quality.run_release_gate`; verdict/enforce/ratchet/
    not-evaluable + the `class_s` signal ride the evidence verbatim.
  - **P1** — `/releases/latest.json` pub = `/release.json` pub; release
    age < 35 d; served `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` = recorded gen; cadence.toml
    declares the `sig-release-pointer`/`sig-release-age`/`sig-conf-gen`
    kinds + an `absent-api-release-*` target.
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py`** (+~125) — `RELEASE_PROBE_KINDS` +
  `check_release` (`sig-release-pointer`: latest↔release pub parity;
  `sig-release-age`: `activated_at` < `max_age_days`; `sig-conf-gen`:
  served header = `conf_gen` field); `_http_get` turns an unreachable
  origin into status-0 red, never a crash; `probe_hosted` dispatches the
  kinds with the spec's `max_age_days`/`trigger`.
- **`ops/cadence.toml`** (+38) — the P1 targets:
  `sig-release-pointer`, `sig-release-age` (35 d), `sig-conf-gen` on the
  web origin + `absent-api-release-unpromoted` — each with cadence +
  trigger points.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_conf.py`** (+~350) — `verb_promote` gains
  `auto_rollback=True`, `rollback_authority="d-g3-8"`, and the
  `rollback_runner`/`alert_hook` test seams. A failed post-check
  journals `failed`, exits the promote lock, then invokes
  `release_reversal.verb_rollback` to the prior latest (or
  `verb_clear_latest` on a first release), fires a recorded
  `release-auto-rollback` alert, and appends `registry/incidents/` note
  + an `incident` journal event naming the failure, the D-G3-8/B-9
  authority, the rollback outcome and the alert — then still raises
  `post-check-failed`. A refused/failed rollback records verbatim, never
  masks. Resume edge: the restore target is read from `conf/<gen-1>`'s
  own latest.json (`publication_id`, or `legacy_floor` for a floor
  serve), never from `current` — a resumed failure can never
  `same-latest`-refuse into serving the failed candidate, and a floor
  serve restores its `legacy-<date>` label instead of clearing.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_pipeline.py`** (+~104) — `verb_verify`/
  `_verify_suite_contexts`/`run_verb` plumb `api_origin`+`api_headers`
  (→ `HttpFetcher`), `api_fetcher`, `covers`, `quality_report`,
  `cadence_path`, `now`; the tree origin wires the conf generation's
  deny map + tombstones + `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` header.
- **`ops/src/ops/cli.py`** (+~50) — `release verify` gains
  `--api-origin`/`--api-header`/`--quality-report`/`--cadence`;
  `probe-hosted` severities read the spec's trigger and a red release
  probe alerts through the recorded channel.

### Test matrix (`tests/ops/test_release_verify_b.py`, 55 tests)

| surface | green path | seeded defect(s) |
|---|---|---|
| V6 | clean recompute | wrong rendered value · unmanifested artifact · missing artifact · pointer miss · stale as-of |
| V7 | fixture API pass | no fetcher → skip · wrong release named · missing basis · slice body mismatch · slice 404 |
| V8 | clean attribution | empty required attribution · record source unattributed · licence-less compartment · map page without holders · bare-id render · handle-shaped render |
| V9 | clean geometry | null island · out-of-range · axis swap (oracle) · oracle absent → skip · undisclosed out-of-boundary · lying rollup |
| V10 | deny-map green | unserved deny · wrong tombstone body · lying conf-gen header · P-mode new+sample probing |
| V14 | prior-release baseline green | compartment breach · dropped source · first-release skip |
| V15 | clean report | enforce failure · not-evaluable enforce · ratchet regression → Class S · absent report → skip-blocks · path loading |
| P1 | promoted tree green | pointer mismatch · stale release · conf-gen mismatch · cadence missing targets |
| probes | cadence declares P1 kinds · `probe_hosted` dispatches them · `check_release` parity + age bound | — |
| auto-rollback | prior-latest restore + alert + incident | first-release clear-latest · **legacy-floor serve restores its label** (never clear-latest) · refused rollback recorded · **resumed-crash** restore · dry-run never rolls back · `auto_rollback=False` posture · injected runner verbatim |

`tests/ops/test_release_verify.py` gains the suite-B fixture surface
(figure artifact, sources/LICENCES indices, map attribution, a real
prior staged release as V14's baseline, `_ApiFixture`,
`_quality_report`, `conf_gen_header`/`deny_conf`/`tombstone_root` wiring)
— the honest P-mode fixture still reports exactly the recorded
`D-P35.56-1` catalog.jsonld gap and nothing else.

`tests/e2e/test_release_verify_composed.py` gains the real loopback API

suite exercises V7/V15/P1 end-to-end.
